name: great-ball
effect: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1.5×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
short_effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 1.5×.

flavor_text.black-white: A good, high-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.
flavor_text.black-2-white-2: A good, high-performance Ball that provides a higher Pokémon catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.
